stages.name: Day one - as bought
stages.summary: The house as the agent's plan draws it: sitting room, hall and family room at the front, kitchen and dining room behind, a single-storey store and lean-to at the back, four bedrooms and a small bathroom upstairs, under a slate roof with a gable and chimney at the west end and a hip at the east.

variants.name: Empty shell
variants.summary: The house on the day the keys arrive: nothing in it.

variants.name: The fittings in the photos
variants.summary: Only what the particulars show fixed in place: the kitchen's sink under the rear window and the bathroom's suite. Whether any of it works is unconfirmed (the agent says the kitchen is not functional).
